verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor/docs citation describing GitHub's code/commit search feature, only community remarks (single tier) noting the feature exists but is widely regarded as broken or inferior to grep, and that MS restricted code search to logged-in users. This confirms the capability exists but with strong quality caveats, not a documented, well-supported feature. missing for 10: official docs describing repo/code/commit search, examples of successful searches, independent benchmarks or hands-on praise validating search quality.
